sites.name: Atlantic Cable Mine & Headframe Complex
sites.location: Rico mining district, Dolores County, Colorado
overview: The Atlantic Cable Mine is documented as one of Rico's early profitable mines. Existing research supports the surviving headframe and associated mine landscape as a stable basic Scan identity.

sites.name: Dunton Mining Camp & Townsite
overview: Dunton is a documented historic mining camp with a substantially intact townscape. Existing research supports the historic camp and surviving buildings as a basic Scan identity; present ownership is background information and does not define access.

sites.name: Enterprise Mine & Newman Hill Silver Complex
sites.location: Rico mining district, Dolores County, Colorado
overview: The Enterprise Mine and Newman Hill workings form a documented major silver-mining complex in the Rico district and contributed prominently to the district's 1893 production peak. Existing research supports the complex as a basic Scan identity.

sites.name: Rico / Pioneer Mining District & Historic Townsite
sites.location: Rico and the Pioneer mining district, Dolores County, Colorado
overview: Rico and the Pioneer mining district form a documented historic mining-town and industrial landscape. Federal geologic research supports the townsite and surrounding district as a basic Scan identity.

sites.name: Rico Rio Grande Southern Railroad Yard & Enginehouse Complex
overview: The Rico Rio Grande Southern yard and enginehouse complex served mining traffic through the Rico district. Existing research supports the surviving archaeological railroad landscape as a basic Scan identity.

sites.name: Rico-Argentine Mine & St. Louis Tunnel Complex
sites.location: Rico mining district, Dolores County, Colorado
overview: The Rico-Argentine Mine and St. Louis Tunnel form a documented interconnected mining and tunnel complex in the Rico district. Existing research supports the visible industrial and remediation landscape as a basic Scan identity.

sites.name: Albion Mine
overview: Albion Mine is a historic named mine in the Rico mining area of Dolores County, preserved as a distinct mine feature on USGS topographic mapping.
moreHistory: The mapped mine location provides a defensible identification target. This record does not claim that a historic opening or other working survives or is accessible today.

sourceReferences.title: USGS Rico topographic mapping — Albion Mine

sites.name: America Mine
overview: The America Mine is a historic silver-gold mine in the Lone Cone (Dunton) mining district of Dolores County. Federal mineral records identify it as a past producer associated with the patented America, Columbia, and Nil Desperandum claims.
timeline: During the historic mining era — The property was developed through the America, Columbia, and Nil Desperandum patented claims.
1910 — The federal mineral record lists the property's last reported production year.
moreHistory: Historic mining records describe four adits driven generally southeast and connected by raises. The documented lower-tunnel location identifies the historic mine site; this does not imply that an opening survives or is accessible today.
